claims.claim_vi: UPI is an instant real-time payment system developed by the National Payments Corporation of India; it accounts for 60% of digital retail transactions in India (the source's figure, "today" when the guide was written) and is still growing.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit. The figure is the source's and was not checked.

claims.claim_vi: UPI = payment markup language + standard for interoperable payments.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Registration: Bob gives his phone number and verifies it with a one-time password; he sets up a virtual payment address; his payment app creates the address with the acquiring bank, which returns it, and the app returns it to Bob.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Linking a bank account: the request goes to NPCI, which acts as a switch between acquiring banks and issuing banks and resolves the account details from the address with the issuing banks; Bob authenticates with account details and sets the PIN, used for two-factor authentication, which goes to the issuing bank.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Direct payment: Alice enters Bob's UPI address and the amount (INR 100); her payment app verifies and forwards the request to NPCI via a bank; NPCI asks Bob's bank to resolve the details, deducts the amount from Alice's bank account, instructs Bob's bank to add it, and on success notifies the payment apps through the acquiring banks.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: The lesson names banks by role, not by the names in the source.
claims.verified_by: Editorial choice; the source names real banks and an app.

design_notes_vi: Khung một là bốn bước chuẩn bị của người nhận; khung hai là lược đồ ba bên cho một lần chuyển, trong đó NPCI đứng giữa. Ngân hàng của Alice không vẽ riêng: bước trừ tiền ở đó có trong phần chữ.
source_deviations: The source names real banks and apps (an app, two acquiring banks and two issuing banks); the lesson names them by role.
The source writes "UPI ID"; the lesson says "địa chỉ UPI" (the address is a virtual payment address) and drops the INR code for "rupee".
The figure leaves out the deduction at Alice's bank to keep three parties; the text below it keeps that step.
